q1_issues.issue: The definite plural 'the student associations on campus' is encoded as a kind-ranging rule premise (Member $a student_association) restricted by (On $a campus), so the rule claims this of every on-campus student association rather than of the specific set the definite plural picks out, which the instruction set requires be a group witness.

No top-level atoms exist for those definite associations at all — their typing and their on-campus position sit only inside the implication, so nothing is asserted about referents the sentence presupposes.
The definite plural subject 'the members' gets only the per-member rule, with no group witness and no group event, where the grouped-plural-with-distributive-predicate pattern keeps both.

notes: Theme for the elected members, the by-phrase group as Agent, the absent tense atom on a habitual present, the student_association genus with its noun modifier unexposed, and the 1.0/0.9 rule TV all follow the instruction set. On is licensed as an entity-attached surface preposition.
